segments.speaker: N
segments.text: One morning, Leo noticed something wrong with his shadow.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: He raised his hand.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: His shadow… yawned.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: He waved. He jumped. He did a full victory dance.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: The shadow just leaned against the wall like, "Bro. It's seven a.m."

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Leo tried to film it, but on camera, it acted completely normal.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: The second he lowered the phone, it took a bow.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: On his way to work, the shadow stopped at the bus stop and pointed at the bus.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Leo said,

segments.speaker: L
segments.text: Since when do shadows pick my bus?

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: And he got on.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Two streets later, the bus skidded into a ditch.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Everyone climbed out, dusty but fine.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: And his shadow was waiting on the sidewalk. Arms folded. Tapping its foot.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: From that day, Leo listened.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: A man called:

segments.speaker: C
segments.text: Hi, this is your bank. Just read me the three digits on the back of your card.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: The shadow facepalmed. Leo hung up.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: When the shadow pointed at the door, Leo said,

segments.speaker: L
segments.text: This is my apartment!

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: The shadow dragged him out by the ankle.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Seconds later, the ceiling fan crashed onto his chair.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Soon, it was picking his outfits. It was never wrong.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Until one night, the light flickered.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: The shadow turned around, pointed straight at Leo, and started shaking.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Leo slowly looked behind him.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: There was a second shadow on the wall.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: It waved. Shyly.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: His shadow wasn't scared. It was nervous. It was introducing its girlfriend.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Now Leo has two shadows. And neither of them lets him eat pizza after midnight.

segments.speaker: N
segments.text: Would you trust your shadow? Comment below.
